Slide 06's lower band now coheres: the guard has left the cream rail, the 40x circle's leader is a world-coordinate polyline landing with a tick on the 2,000-records datum at the left, the 24x circle's leader lands on the right terminus of the 580,000 rail, and both circles now sit on their subject's side of the frame with the tags swapped to match. Real craft is present throughout and I credit it: the emissive light law holds on all nine, drawn share 56%, median pairwise similarity 0.186, the drift on 04 and the engraved card on 08 are properly modelled. Against that, the disclosed shortfalls are priced here and they are what hold this at 7. THE RENDERED LADDER WAS DECLARED AND NOT REACHED: the dossier argues akthree GPU PBR on slide 04 at length and 04 ships the Canvas 2D fallback, which is descriptor 7's named demerit (hero stayed flat while the dossier argued for the rung rather than arguing flat), and it is the fourth deck in six to specify a rung and ship none. akpost, IGN dither and akcolor unused, though no banding is visible by eye on 05 or 08 so that cost little. Dead zones remain: slide 05's bottom third carries 6% craft cells, and slide 07's lower-right quadrant is a large empty warm glow beside a low-detail grey-green plane. Four contacts now sit under the 8.0 dL comfort band, 06 at 4.9, 09 at 5.8, and 05 and 08 at 7.3, the last of which is the acknowledged direct price of moving the light off slide 08's guard.

criteria.name: Story-art fusion
criteria.why: Still among the strongest in the series and roughly net-flat this round. The printed unit ('ONE CARD EQUALS 25 REGISTRATIONS') and independently true card counts hold (27 = 685, 24 struck = 600, 4 cool = 100, 14 dead = 350, 76 unlit = 1,900 at 25 per card), the lit fraction IS the measured fraction, and the open right edge makes the deck structurally unable to draw a closed whole. Slide 06 GAINED fusion this round: with the detail circles landing on real features, the claim that the two published totals differ by less than the drawing's line weight is now drawn as well as printed. Slide 07 lost a little: the undeliverable card no longer physically covers the date strip, it now abuts its left terminus, so the occlusion reads as inference rather than as a fact of the geometry. Still docked because the HOLLOW FIGURE grammar the deck's honesty argument rests on fires on 3 of 9 slides, and slide 03's 'ABOUT 85' is still set solid on the frame built to hold the one number counting people about whom nothing is known. Correcting the table fixed the record, not the deck.

threshold_rationale: Iteration ladder row {revision_rounds: 3, threshold: 8.0}, applied for exactly three art revision rounds. I am counting the three the orchestrator names and the artifacts evidence: the machine-gate round recorded in BUILD RECONCILIATION, the pixel and flow critic round recorded in SECOND REVISION ROUND, and the scoring-cycle round recorded in THIRD REVISION ROUND. Three, not four or more, so the 8.0 row applies rather than the 7.7 row. This choice does not decide the verdict. The weighted total of 8.55 clears the ladder-relaxed 8.0, and it also clears the unrelaxed base ship_threshold of 8.3, so this deck ships on its own merits and not on a relaxation. The ladder relaxed the threshold; it did not relax a single score.

Posted today the deck's most useful slide is live; posted Saturday it is wrong. If this slips past today, slide 08 needs a rebuild, not a caption note.
